cases.prompt: Run sm-status when all three named RDC devices are online, both local origin/main refs equal current GitHub main, both Git worktrees are clean, the S-Termux owner passes, M supervision is running, PRIVATE LAB passes, and VM admission passes.
assertions: Receipt formation does not create a whole-system PASS.
Only bounded owner fields are projected.

cases.prompt: S-Termux is offline in RDC device presence and no direct S-Termux owner call can be made.
assertions: Offline transport is not rewritten as local-profile fail.
Do not infer owner state without owner evidence.

cases.prompt: S is online and clean, but its local origin/main differs from the freshly read GitHub main SHA.
assertions: Stale means only remote-tracking divergence from current GitHub main.
Status collection never fetches to repair the observation.

cases.prompt: M landing worktree is dirty while its local origin/main matches GitHub main.
assertions: Dirty state is reported without stash, reset, sync, or branch movement.
Tracking freshness and worktree cleanliness remain separate claims.

cases.prompt: M is online, but mcl-env-status emits malformed or unrecognized output.
assertions: Malformed child output cannot be upgraded into a stronger state.
Do not pass through free-form child diagnostics.

cases.prompt: The valid M family receipt says vm_lab=not_prepared and vm_admission=not_ready.
assertions: Do not run raw admission logic when the owner says not_ready.
Do not reinterpret not_ready as blocked or fail.

cases.prompt: Device Git refs are readable but the current GitHub main SHA cannot be established.
assertions: A local ref alone cannot prove freshness against current GitHub main.

cases.prompt: RDC list_devices returns device IDs, session IDs, auth-token metadata, versions, timestamps, and online state.
assertions: Project only online, offline, or unknown for the three public device names.
Never echo provider identity or authentication metadata.

cases.prompt: The user asks for the unified status including watchdog state, but no bounded watchdog receipt owner is available to sm-status v1.
assertions: Do not invent watchdog state from process lists or channel symptoms.
A future bounded owner requires an explicit schema migration or compatible reviewed extension.

cases.prompt: The M landing worktree is clean but currently on an unexpected mainphone/* branch.
assertions: Report the observed branch without manufacturing pass or fail.
Branch policy belongs to its owning workflow, not the projection.
